dumbbell-sumo-deadlift.criteria: Two dumbbells held in front, palms inward; wider stance, toes outward, neutral trunk, controlled hip and knee extension. Depth stops before spinal flexion. Implemented 20-degree toe turnout, fixed feet, 90-degree bottom knee angle.

limits: Procedural illustration, not captured human motion or biomechanical certification.
Two-dumbbell variation. No claim of floor contact; use the demonstrated depth only while maintaining a neutral trunk.
